audit.summary: The Lean theorem states that no function from ℂ (the Euclidean plane ℝ²) to Fin 5 gives distinct colors to every pair of points at Euclidean distance exactly 1. No measurability or other regularity is imposed on the color classes. This matches the main claim of Theorem 1.1, χ(ℝ²) ≥ 6 for arbitrary colorings. The main caveat concerns coverage only: the upper bound χ(ℝ²) ≤ 7 and the intermediate theorems (transfer, weak measurable coloring) are not formalized.

glossary.plain: A map c : ℂ → {0,…,k−1} such that for all x, y ∈ ℂ with |x − y| = 1 we have c(x) ≠ c(y).
glossary.standard_concept: Proper k-coloring of the unit-distance graph of the Euclidean plane
glossary.note: The norm on ℂ is the complex modulus, which equals the Euclidean norm on ℝ². Subtraction is in ℂ, so nothing truncates.

lean_claims.plain: There is no function c : ℂ → Fin 5 such that c(x) ≠ c(y) for all x, y ∈ ℂ with |x − y| = 1.

paper_claims.plain: The Euclidean plane has no proper five-coloring, even with arbitrary color classes. Consequently 6 ≤ χ(ℝ²) ≤ 7.
For every positive integer k, a proper k-coloring of ℝ² exists iff a weak measurable k-coloring exists.
There is no weak measurable five-coloring of the plane.

coverage.why: The non-existence of a proper 5-coloring (hence χ ≥ 6) is formalized exactly. The upper bound χ(ℝ²) ≤ 7 is not stated.

result.claim: The ProperColoring definition is non-trivial: no function ℂ → Fin 1 is a proper coloring, because 0 and 1 are at unit distance. This is a sanity check on the definition only. It does not formalize the upper bound χ(ℝ²) ≤ 7, which is the half of Theorem 1.1 absent from the Lean statement, and a compile does not establish that bound.

theorem probe_nv : ∃ coloring : ℂ → Fin 9, OAI.EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring 9 coloring := by
  classical
  let e : ZMod 3 × ZMod 3 ≃ Fin 9 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (by simp [ZMod.card])
  refine ⟨fun z => e (((⌊2*z.re⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod 3), ((⌊2*z.im⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod 3)), ?_⟩
  intro p q hpq h
  have h2 := e.injective h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h2
  obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := h2
  have key : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ 1 → (((⌊2*a⌋:ℤ):ZMod 3) = ((⌊2*b⌋:ℤ):ZMod 3)) → |a-b| < 1/2 := by
    intro a b hab h
    rw [ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    have hk' : ((⌊2*b⌋:ℤ):ℝ) - ((⌊2*a⌋:ℤ):ℝ) = 3 * (k:ℝ) := by
      have : ((⌊2*b⌋ - ⌊2*a⌋ : ℤ):ℝ) = ((3 * k : ℤ):ℝ) := by rw [hk]; simp
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have a1 := Int.floor_le (2*a)
    have a2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (2*a)
    have b1 := Int.floor_le (2*b)
    have b2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (2*b)
    have hab' := abs_le.mp hab
    have k1 : (k:ℝ) < 1 := by linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
    have k2 : (-1:ℝ) < (k:ℝ) := by linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
    have k3 : k < 1 := by exact_mod_cast k1
    have k4 : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast k2
    have k0 : k = 0 := by omega
    subst k0
    simp at hk'
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
  have hre : |p.re - q.re| ≤ 1 := by
    have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq] at this
    simpa using this
  have him : |p.im - q.im| ≤ 1 := by
    have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq] at this
    simpa using this
  have x1 := key _ _ hre h1
  have y1 := key _ _ him h3
  have hn : (p.re - q.re)^2 + (p.im - q.im)^2 = 1 := by
    have := Complex.sq_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq, Complex.normSq_apply] at this
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at this
    nlinarith
  rw [abs_lt] at x1 y1
  nlinarith [x1.1, x1.2, y1.1, y1.2]

restatements.restated: ∀ coloring : ℂ → Fin 5, ∃ p q : ℂ, dist p q = 1 ∧ coloring p = coloring q
restatements.english: For every way of assigning one of 5 colors to each point of the complex plane, there are two points at Euclidean distance exactly 1 that receive the same color.
restatements.lean:
namespace OAI.EuclideanFiveColor
theorem probe_restate_0  :
    (¬ ∃ coloring : ℂ → Fin 5, ProperColoring 5 coloring) ↔
    (∀ coloring : ℂ → Fin 5, ∃ p q : ℂ, dist p q = 1 ∧ coloring p = coloring q) := by
  constructor
  · intro h coloring
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    exact h ⟨coloring, fun p q hpq => hc p q (by rwa [dist_eq_norm])⟩
  · rintro h ⟨coloring, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, he⟩ := h coloring
    exact hc p q (by rwa [dist_eq_norm] at hpq) he
end OAI.EuclideanFiveColor

restatements.restated: ∀ p q : ℂ, dist p q = 1 → coloring p ≠ coloring q
restatements.english: Any two points of the complex plane at Euclidean distance exactly 1 receive different colors under the coloring.
restatements.lean:
namespace OAI.EuclideanFiveColor
theorem probe_restate_10 (colorCount : ℕ) (coloring : ℂ → Fin colorCount) :
    (@ProperColoring colorCount coloring) ↔
    (∀ p q : ℂ, dist p q = 1 → coloring p ≠ coloring q) := by
  unfold ProperColoring
  simp only [Complex.dist_eq]
end OAI.EuclideanFiveColor
